title: Unreal Announcer for Hypixel Skyblock
description: Adds unreal announcer for hypixel skyblock killstreaks events.
body:
# Unreal Announcer for SkyBlock

A client-side Fabric mod that brings the Unreal Tournament announcer to Hypixel SkyBlock. As your Kill Combo climbs, an escalating ladder of voice lines calls out your rampage: Multi Kill, Mega Kill, Ultra Kill, Monster Kill, Killing Spree, Rampage, Dominating, Unstoppable, and finally Godlike.

## Features:
- Fully configurable: remap any combo threshold to any clip, tune the volume and reset window, live-reload with /unrealannouncer reload
- /unrealannouncer test <clip> to preview any line
- Client-side only, no server install needed
